name: Views RSS: Yandex Elements
description: Provides Yandex XML namespace and item elements for Views RSS.
project_description: Adds Yandex/Dzen-specific XML namespaces, channel and item elements to feeds produced by the Views RSS module. Per Dzen.News technical requirements a feed needs the namespaces xmlns:yandex="http://news.yandex.ru" and xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/"; this module registers both plus the item elements yandex:full-text, yandex:genre and yandex:enclosure so any Views field output can be mapped to them through the Views RSS UI. It also ships a dedicated Views style plugin ("Yandex RSS Feed - Fields") with a per-feed Yandex Turbo toggle that, when enabled, adds the xmlns:turbo namespace and wraps the full-text field in turbo:content markup. Depends on views_rss and its views_rss_core submodule.
